open.title: Preserve usable operation-page space beneath constrained sticky tabs

locations.role: New regression selects navigation instead of a page control
Sticky nav precedes operation tool pages
Geometry page remains below sticky nav

open.body: At 1024 × 768 with comfortable density, the wrapped measurement and open operations dock leave a 42.421875 px body (clientHeight 42), for both light/dark themes and both 180/600 saved dock sizes. The new cap protects the canvas but retains `.operation-tabs { position: sticky; top: -8px; padding-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: 1px; z-index: 2 }`. Its 32 px button makes the navigation at least 39 px tall. Even granting the full negative 8 px offset, at most 42.421875 − (39 − 8) = 11.421875 px remains unobscured for the actual page, below the 32 px minimum of its controls. Ordinary scrolling cannot expose a full page control beneath that persistent cover. The test passes because `.first()` selects the 32 px Review changes navigation button, which fits at y=655.984375…687.984375 inside the y=647.984375…689.984375 client clip; it never proves a control below the navigation can be fully displayed.
open.evidenceCalibration: Existing raw screenshot/body/tab geometry is directly observed; the inability to display a32px page control is a source-backed geometric consequence of the sticky rule. Reviewer ran no browser. No claim that the author attempted and failed that missing interaction.
open.narrowRepair: Let operation navigation scroll away when the dock is constrained, or equivalently release sufficient actual page space without lowering the200px canvas, measurement readability, pointer targets or preference invariants. The smallest direction is changing constrained sticky behavior, not redesigning the workspace.
open.requiredBackcheck: Use ordinary navigation to an operation-tool page (for example Geometry), then ordinary scrolling/focus to an actual enabled page input/select/button. Preserve exact full-border containment and pointer ownership, account for sticky occlusion, and retain existing canvas/readout/draft/preferences/overflow checks. Verify that the frozen bad preimage fails the strengthened page-control witness. A navigation-tab witness or arbitrary replacement body floor is insufficient.
